notices.title: Public Notice of Public Hearing to Consider CUP for Mountain American Credit Union for an Accessory Drive-Through Facility
notices.agenda_text:
PUBLIC NOTICE

NOTICE IS HERBY GIVEN THAT the Tooele Planning Commission will hold a public hearing during their business meeting scheduled for Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Council Chambers of City Hall located at 90 North Main Street, Tooele, Utah. 

The complete public notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov, the Tooele City Website www.tooelecity.gov, and at Tooele City Hall in Suite 227. To request a copy of the public notice and for additional inquiries please contact the Tooele City Planner, Anna Anglin, at (435) 843-2132 or annaa@tooelecity.gov 

Public Hearing to consider a Conditional Use Permit request by Brook Bean, representing Mountain America Credit Union, to authorize an 'Accessory Drive-Through Facility' for Mountain America Credit Union and to relocate Janna's Java to the north side of the property, also with an 'Accessory Drive-Through Facility.' The property is located at approximately 47 East 400 North, consists of approximately 1.91 acres, and is zoned GC General Commercial.

Tooele City public meetings may be recorded and transcribed for documentation and quality assurance purposes. By attending this meeting, you consent to being recorded.  If you do not consent, we encourage you to join the Planning Commission meeting electronically by visiting the Tooele City YouTube Channel, at https://www.youtube.com/@tooelecity or by going to YouTube.com and searching 'Tooele City Channel'. If you are attending electronically and would like to submit a written comment for a public hearing item, please email pcpubliccomment@tooelecity.gov.  If submission by email is not an option, written comments may be submitted to the City Planner.  Written comments must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. the day before the hearing.  Written comments will be addressed at the designated points in the meeting.

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, individuals needing special accommodation should notify Anna Anglin, Tooele City Planner/ Zoning Administrator at (435) 843-2132 prior to the meeting.

2. Roll Call

3.
